SELECT q.job_id, q.capture_id, q.bundle_id, q.queue_rank, q.incident_id, q.host_ip, q.zeekad_role, q.event_start, q.event_end, q.zeekad_picked_by, q.zeekad_also_flagged_by, q.connection_count, q.host_name, COALESCE(s.zeekad_status, lq.zeekad_status, 'open') AS zeekad_status, s.zeekad_resolution, COALESCE(s.updated_at, lq.status_updated_at) AS status_updated_at, COALESCE(lq.zeekad_report_job_id, self_r.job_id) AS zeekad_report_job_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(lq.zeekad_report_job_id, self_r.job_id) IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_report, COALESCE(r.zeekad_report_kind, lq.zeekad_report_kind) AS zeekad_report_kind, r.zeekad_verification_passed, COALESCE(d.zeekad_would_send, lq.zeekad_would_send, FALSE) AS zeekad_would_send, COALESCE(lq.zeekad_review_action, arq.zeekad_review_action) AS zeekad_review_action, COALESCE( lq.zeekad_review_pending, CASE WHEN arq.incident_id IS NOT NULL AND arq.zeekad_review_action IS NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END ) AS zeekad_review_pending,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dashboard.slack_deliveries sdl WHERE sdl.incident_id = q.incident_id AND sdl.zeekad_message_version IS NOT NULL AND sdl.zeekad_message_version NOT LIKE 'status:%' ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS alerted FROM dashboard.incident_queue q LEFT JOIN dashboard.latest_incident_queue lq ON lq.incident_id = q.incident_id LEFT JOIN dashboard.incident_status s ON s.incident_id = q.incident_id LEFT JOIN dashboard.incident_reports self_r ON self_r.job_id = q.job_id AND self_r.incident_id = q.incident_id LEFT JOIN dashboard.incident_reports r ON r.job_id = COALESCE(lq.zeekad_report_job_id, self_r.job_id) AND r.incident_id = q.incident_id LEFT JOIN dashboard.send_decisions d ON d.job_id = COALESCE(lq.zeekad_report_job_id, self_r.job_id) AND d.incident_id = q.incident_id LEFT JOIN dashboard.analyst_review_queue arq ON arq.job_id = COALESCE(lq.zeekad_report_job_id, self_r.job_id) AND arq.incident_id = q.incident_id
mapper.select:
AND q.job_id = #{jobId}
AND LOWER(q.zeekad_picked_by) = LOWER(#{pickedBy})
AND LOWER(q.zeekad_role) = LOWER(#{role})
AND LOWER(COALESCE(s.zeekad_status, lq.zeekad_status, 'open')) = LOWER(#{status})
AND COALESCE(lq.zeekad_report_job_id, self_r.job_id) IS NOT NULL
AND COALESCE(lq.zeekad_report_job_id, self_r.job_id) IS NULL
AND COALESCE(d.zeekad_would_send, lq.zeekad_would_send, FALSE) = #{wouldSend}
ORDER BY q.queue_rank ASC

SELECT job_id, incident_id, zeekad_report_kind, zeekad_report_version, zeekad_input_version, zeekad_report, zeekad_verification_passed, zeekad_verification_reason, zeekad_verification_problems, llm_model_requested, llm_model_version, llm_seconds, llm_input_tokens, llm_output_tokens, llm_thinking_tokens, llm_error, zeekad_attack_candidates, zeekad_source_run, created_at, zeekad_facts, zeekad_pseudonyms FROM dashboard.incident_reports WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND incident_id = #{incidentId}

SELECT job_id, incident_id, zeekad_would_send, zeekad_decided_by, policy_id, policy_choice, policy_mandatory, policy_reasons, llm_choice, decision_model, decision_model_choice, decision_model_confidence, decision_model_probabilities, decision_model_error, zeekad_source_run, created_at FROM dashboard.send_decisions WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND incident_id = #{incidentId}

SELECT job_id, incident_id, zeekad_message_kind, zeekad_message_version, zeekad_delivery_mode, zeekad_delivery_status, slack_payload, slack_ts, delivered_at, error, created_at, zeekad_thread_parent, zeekad_reply_broadcast FROM dashboard.slack_deliveries WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, job_id ASC
SELECT job_id, incident_id, zeekad_status, zeekad_resolution, updated_at, updated_by FROM dashboard.incident_status WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT job_id, incident_id, from_status, to_status, zeekad_resolution, actor, reason, changed_at FROM dashboard.incident_status_history WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId} ORDER BY changed_at DESC

SELECT COALESCE(lq.job_id, a.job_id) AS job_id, a.job_id AS review_job_id, COALESCE(lq.capture_id, j.capture_id) AS capture_id, a.incident_id, COALESCE(lq.queue_rank, a.queue_rank) AS queue_rank, COALESCE(lq.host_ip, a.host_ip) AS host_ip, COALESCE(lq.zeekad_role, a.zeekad_role) AS zeekad_role, a.zeekad_review_reason, a.requested_at, a.zeekad_review_action, a.analyst, a.decided_at, a.zeekad_review_resumed_at, a.zeekad_review_resume_failed FROM dashboard.analyst_review_queue a LEFT JOIN dashboard.latest_incident_queue lq ON lq.incident_id = a.incident_id LEFT JOIN dashboard.scoring_jobs j ON j.job_id = a.job_id
AND (lq.incident_id IS NULL OR a.job_id = lq.zeekad_report_job_id) AND (lq.incident_id IS NOT NULL OR a.job_id = ( SELECT MAX(a2.job_id) FROM dashboard.analyst_review_queue a2 WHERE a2.incident_id = a.incident_id ))
AND COALESCE(lq.capture_id, j.capture_id) = #{captureId}
AND a.zeekad_review_action IS NULL
ORDER BY a.requested_at DESC, COALESCE(lq.job_id, a.job_id) DESC, COALESCE(lq.queue_rank, a.queue_rank) ASC

SELECT a.job_id AS job_id, a.job_id AS review_job_id, j.capture_id AS capture_id, a.incident_id, a.queue_rank, a.host_ip, a.zeekad_role, a.zeekad_review_reason, a.requested_at, a.zeekad_review_action, a.analyst, a.decided_at, a.zeekad_review_resumed_at, a.zeekad_review_resume_failed FROM dashboard.analyst_review_queue a LEFT JOIN dashboard.scoring_jobs j ON j.job_id = a.job_id WHERE a.job_id = #{jobId} AND a.incident_id = #{incidentId} LIMIT 1
